subject: crab
readings: Head/mouth is fused into the carapace (no neck, no head leaf). In the XZ (top) panel the two claws sit at tick_z≈0-4 (top of that panel); because z is the UP axis in the XZ panel while ticks run downward, this flips to actual z≈20-24 (large +z). The ZY (profile) panel confirms the raised claw/pincer sits at tick_z≈13-24 (right side), i.e. large +z, matching. So the head/mouth end of the animal is at +z. Because the crab is widest across its claws (x-axis, tick 0 to 24 in the XY panel = its longest extent), the XY panel shows the FRONT of the animal and the ZY panel is the PROFILE (z=front/back axis, y=up/down).

Carapace bounding box: XY panel shows the carapace spanning tick x≈4-20 (width ~16u, centered x≈12). ZY panel shows the carapace spanning tick z≈6-20 (depth ~14u) and tick y≈6-16, i.e. actual y (24-tick) ≈8-18 (height ~10u).

Claw geometry (ZY panel): base attaches to carapace at tick (z=13,y=16) -> actual y=24-16=8; elbow bend at tick (z=16,y=9) -> actual y=15; tip/pincer at tick (z=20,y=2) -> actual y=22. So from base to tip the claw direction is +z (forward) and +y (upward) - it is a raised limb, not a leg.

Walking-leg attachment row (ZY panel): hip line runs along the carapace at tick y≈14 (actual y=10), staggered across tick z≈9,12,15,18 for the four leg pairs (pair 1 nearest the claws/front, pair 4 nearest the rear). Each leg's knee bends near tick y≈19 (actual y=5) and the foot reaches tick y≈24 (actual y=0, ground), so dy is negative from hip->knee->foot as required.

XY (front) panel: the eight leg feet and two claw tips spread laterally from tick x≈0 (leftmost) to tick x≈24 (rightmost), symmetric about the carapace center tick x≈12, confirming legs/claws run along ±x for the animal's left/right sides.

XZ (top) panel: legs occupy tick_z≈8-20 (screen), i.e. actual z (24-tick) ≈4-16, confirming the four leg rows sit progressively further back (toward -z, low actual z) than the claw attachment which sits at actual z≈20-24.
notes: Crab: cephalothorax (carapace) is a single fused trunk with no separate head leaf (mouth/eyes do not protrude as a distinct lobe). Ten leaves total: 2 chelae (claws) + 8 walking legs (4 pairs), no external tail. Spine authored as a short front-to-back chain (carapace -> carapace_front -> row1..row4) so each of the four leg-pair rows and the claw pair attach at their own point along the body rather than at one hub, matching the mesh's actual attachment lines seen in the ZY/XZ panels. Each limb was split into two segments by inference: claws into upper-arm (merus-like) + tip (chela), legs into hip/knee + foot; the render only clearly shows one strong bend per limb so a 2-segment chain was used rather than over-splitting. All four leg pairs were authored with IDENTICAL segment lengths/directions (only their spine attachment point differs) even though the render shows them at different mid-stride phases, per the proportion-not-pose rule. Left/right assigned by animal's own sides given head/front established at +z; +x taken as the animal's right, -x as its left. Vertical (dy) sign was checked: hip->knee->foot for every leg is negative (goes down toward the ground), and root length is 0 with direction [0,0,0] as required.
